tools.name: GetProductDetails
tools.description:
Finds all bicycle details and returns the information in following structure:
Title: Bicycle name
Description: Features or purpose
ReleaseDate: ISO 8601 timestamp
Dimensions: "Length x Width x Height"

tools.name: GetPartDetails
tools.description:
Finds all bicycle part details and returns the information in the following structure:

Title: The name of the part.
Description: A brief description of the part's function or features.
ReleaseDate: The date the part was released, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
Dimensions: The dimensions of the part in a "Length x Width x Height" format.
Weight: The weight of the part in kilograms.
StockQuantity: The number of items available in stock.
Supplier: The name of the supplier or manufacturer of the part.
ImageURL: A URL linking to an image of the part.
BoxDimensions: The dimensions of the box containing the part, in a "Length x Width x Height" format.
PartAmountPerCrate: The number of parts included in one crate.
IsFragile: A boolean value indicating whether the part is fragile.
Products: A list of related products that use this part, with each product including:
Title: The name of the related product.

tools.name: RaiseSAPPurchaseOrder
tools.description:
Raises a purchase order in the SAP system for a single part.

Parameters:
- ItemName (string, required): the exact part Title as returned by GetPartDetails.
- Quantity (integer, required): the number of units to order.

Behaviour: creates the PO immediately and returns a confirmation string, e.g.
"Purchase order Lig-632 for Lightweight Alloy Wheels from Mavic created for 50 items."
There is no human confirmation step in this tool — enforce any sign-off before calling it.
